# OpenAPI and AsyncAPI

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from api_spec/lang.json and api_spec/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

This page helps you build, test and check OpenAPI and AsyncAPI code with rules_dx.

## Quick start

`MODULE.bazel` sits at the root of your repository and lists the Bazel modules, meaning external dependencies, that your project uses. Add `rules_dx` to it:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

Then let dx set up the rest, as in the [Quickstart](../../README.md#quickstart):

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- init --apply
```

For a OpenAPI and AsyncAPI project, `MODULE.bazel` then looks like this:

```python
module(name = "my_project")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

A `BUILD.bazel` file declares targets: the libraries, binaries and tests that Bazel builds. This one is a small OpenAPI and AsyncAPI package from [`api_spec/tests/consumer`](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/api_spec/tests/consumer/BUILD.bazel):

```python
load("@rules_dx//api_spec:defs.bzl", "api_spec_library")

api_spec_library(
    name = "api_spec",
    srcs = ["openapi.yaml"],
    visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
)
```

Build and test everything. `//...` means every target in the repository:

```sh
tools/dx test //...
```

## Rules

`load` brings rules into a `BUILD.bazel` file. Load the ones you use from `@rules_dx//api_spec:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//api_spec:defs.bzl", "api_spec_go_client", "api_spec_library", "api_spec_python_client")
```

### `api_spec_go_client`

Generates one Go client file (types and client) with oapi-codegen from an OpenAPI root of an api_spec_library.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `out` | `string` | no | Output file name; defaults to NAME.go. |
| `package` | `string` | yes | Go package name of the generated file. |
| `root` | `label` | no | The root document; required when the spec has more than one. |
| `spec` | `label` | yes | The api_spec_library to generate from. |
| `_driver` | `label` | no |  |
| `_oapi_codegen` | `label` | no |  |
| `_preflight` | `label` | no |  |

### `api_spec_library`

Owns the OpenAPI and AsyncAPI documents of one package for dx quality.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Root OpenAPI or AsyncAPI documents to lint. |
| `refs` | `label_list` | no | Files the roots reach through relative $ref. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Spec libraries the roots reach through relative $ref. |

### `api_spec_python_client`

Generates one Python client package directory with openapi-python-client from an OpenAPI root of an api_spec_library.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `out` | `string` | no | Output directory name; defaults to NAME. |
| `root` | `label` | no | The root document; required when the spec has more than one. |
| `spec` | `label` | yes | The api_spec_library to generate from. |
| `_config` | `label` | no |  |
| `_generator` | `label` | no |  |
| `_preflight` | `label` | no |  |

### `api_spec_rust_client`

Generates one Rust client file with progenitor from an OpenAPI root of an api_spec_library. The file needs progenitor-client, reqwest, serde and serde_json at compile time.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `out` | `string` | no | Output file name; defaults to NAME.rs. |
| `root` | `label` | no | The root document; required when the spec has more than one. |
| `spec` | `label` | yes | The api_spec_library to generate from. |
| `_generator` | `label` | no |  |
| `_preflight` | `label` | no |  |

### `api_spec_typescript_client`

Generates one self-contained TypeScript client from an OpenAPI root of an api_spec_library.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `out` | `string` | no | Output file name; defaults to NAME.ts. |
| `root` | `label` | no | The root document; required when the spec has more than one. |
| `spec` | `label` | yes | The api_spec_library to generate from. |
| `_config` | `label` | no |  |
| `_preflight` | `label` | no |  |
| `_redocly` | `label` | no |  |

### `api_spec_protobuf_doc_shard`

```python
api_spec_protobuf_doc_shard(name, proto, package = "", **kwargs)
```

Declares the DocIr shard of one proto_library.

## Tools and package files

dx runs these tools and reads these package files for OpenAPI and AsyncAPI:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Tools | `prettier`, `redocly` |
| Ecosystems | none |
| Manifests | none |
| Lockfiles | none |

## Platforms

OpenAPI and AsyncAPI builds and tests on:

- Linux arm64
- Linux x86_64
- macOS arm64
- Windows arm64
- Windows x86_64
